text:
laura_finance: Heads up, BrightLabs submitted a billing dispute for Feb showing a large unexpected spike. They claim streaming usage was inflated. Pasted their note below.
sam_support: customer wrote: 'On 2026-02-15 our /v1/streams usage jumped to ~2.1M tokens, usually ~200k/day. Please freeze billing while you investigate.'
laura_finance: @ingrid_runtime any deploys or infra changes around 2026-02-15 that could affect stream metering keys?
ingrid_runtime: We deployed a small change that altered the persist key shape for stream ACKs at ~03:11 UTC. Quick signal from canary showed increased duplicate events. Possible double-count for a short window.
ingrid_runtime: example runtime trace:
```
[2026-02-15T03:11:58Z] session=se-124 req=rcv_X3b init stream
[2026-02-15T03:11:59Z] req=rcv_X3b emit tokens=1580 seq=42
[2026-02-15T03:12:01Z] session_disconnect se-124 reason=network_reset
[2026-02-15T03:12:02Z] session_resume se-124 resync tokens=1580 seq=42
```
ingrid_runtime: That sequence looks like the same token block was emitted twice because the dedupe key used persist.format_v2 which briefly changed.
chetan_sre: We rolled that change out for 2 minutes then rolled back at 03:13 UTC when telemetry failed the smoke tests. I can pull deploy tags and the list of accounts impacted.
olga_prodops: Do we know if only BrightLabs affected or multiple tenants? We should scope before approving any credits.
sam_support: No other CS reports yet; pinged the rest of CS to check their customers.
laura_finance: If it's limited to one or a handful, finance can approve targeted credits. If larger, we need an incident billing correction plan.
ingrid_runtime: Plan: run a readonly dedupe query keyed on stream_event.id + event_seq to surface duplicates, then build a correction delta table for billing to ingest. Readonly discovery ~1h, correction script ~2h, safe apply ~1h. Example discovery SQL:
```
-- locate duplicate emit windows
SELECT account_id, request_id, event_seq, COUNT(*) as dup_count
FROM metering.stream_events
WHERE emitted_at >= '2026-02-15T03:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND emitted_at <= '2026-02-15T03:20:00Z'::timestamptz
GROUP BY account_id, request_id, event_seq
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
ingrid_runtime: I'll run discovery in readonly and post counts. If validated, I'll populate billing_corrections.stream_dedupe_{runid} with token_dedup and checksum for audit.
laura_finance: @olga_prodops what's the credit approval flow?
olga_prodops: Finance guideline: isolated incidents with credit < $25k can get provisional credit while we verify. Need ops lead signoff and billing ticket.
sam_support: I asked BrightLabs for a few request_ids to cross-check. They've provided 4 ids.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket: CB-3309 linked to INV-2026-02-BRIGHT.
chetan_sre: Deploy metadata: commit 83d1f4 touched stream_ack persistence keys. There was a migration in key prefix which would change dedupe partitioning for ~90 seconds. Likely duplicates for sessions that reconnected.
ingrid_runtime: Discovery result (readonly): for BrightLabs found 16 duplicated windows, duplicate_tokens=1,741,980. I'll compute USD equivalent and produce correction rows.
laura_finance: Ok provisional credit ceiling $18,000 approved pending final verification. Please produce token->USD calc showing unit price used and exchange rounding.
chetan_sre: I'll schedule a short postmortem with runtime and infra tomorrow.
billing-bot: Provisional credit issued: CR-9027 amount=$17,972 status=pending-verification.
olga_prodops: Owners: ingrid_runtime -> remediation/backfill, sam_support -> customer comms, laura_finance -> final approval, chetan_sre -> postmortem. I'll draft incident blurb after remediation.
sam_support: BrightLabs asked for ETA on fix; told them we're running readonly analysis then a safe correction write and estimate ~3 hours.
ingrid_runtime: Starting backfill in 15m under maintenance lock. Will snapshot correction rows for audit and then hand off to billing ingest.
laura_finance: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with completion and audit artifacts.
